ارتجعوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَعُوا (irtajaʕū) /ir.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# اُرْتُجِعُوا (urtujiʕū) /ur.tu.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# اِرْتَجِعُوا (irtajiʕū) /ir.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
